q: What year did Back to the Future come out in theaters?
explain: 1985. It is right at the top of your fact sheet.

q: How fast does the DeLorean have to go to travel through time?
explain: 88 miles per hour, exactly. Doc built the whole machine around that number. It is on your fact sheet under By the numbers.

q: Who says "Great Scott!" every time something amazing happens?
explain: Doc Brown. It is his favorite thing to shout, so we named our trivia box after it.

q: Put the night of the lightning storm in order.
items: Marty plays Johnny B. Goode at the school dance
A falling branch knocks the cable loose from the clock tower
Doc slides down the cable to plug it back in
Lightning hits the clock tower and Marty vanishes
explain: Dance first, then the cable comes loose, Doc reconnects it at the last second, and the lightning sends Marty home.

q: In 1955, Marty's own mom Lorraine gets a crush on him.
explain: True, and it is a big problem: she is supposed to fall for George, or Marty will never be born.

q: Where we're going, we don't need ____.
explain: Roads! Doc says it right before the DeLorean lifts off the ground at the very end.

q: Why does Marty dress up in the radiation suit and call himself 'Darth Vader from the planet Vulcan'?
options: To scare George into asking Lorraine to the dance
To hide from Biff and his gang
explain: George would not listen to Marty, so Marty gave him a midnight visit from space to push him toward Lorraine.

q: At the end of the movie, how did Doc survive being shot by the Libyans?
options: He taped the letter back together, read it, and wore a bulletproof vest
Marty pushed him out of the way just in time
The Libyans ran out of bullets and drove away
explain: Doc kept the pieces of Marty's letter for 30 years and decided the warning was worth the risk.

q: Why do Marty's brother and sister start disappearing from the family photo?
options: Marty accidentally stopped his parents from falling in love
The photo got wet in the time machine
Biff tore the photo on purpose
explain: Marty pushed his dad out of the way of the car, so his mom fell for Marty instead of George. No love story means no kids!

q: Tap Mr. Fusion, the machine on the roof that runs the DeLorean on garbage.
explain: That little unit on the roof replaced the plutonium. Doc fills it with banana peels and old beer in the last scene.
